# Onyx CMMC

Onyx, a trade name of ETaye LLC in Arlington, Virginia, focuses on customer acquisition for CMMC service firms. Defense suppliers seeking outside help can request an introduction. Onyx checks fit and asks permission before sharing a supplier’s details. Independent service providers handle technical discovery, proposals, contracts, pricing, delivery and support. Onyx may receive a referral fee if the supplier hires the provider.
